name: @nexus/onboarding-failure
description: Nexus onboarding forced-failure suite (EP-035 M4): composes the REAL @nexus/onboarding integration layer against REAL PostgreSQL 18.4 + NATS 2.14.3 containers and proves fail-closed behavior under terminated providers, exhausted budgets, corrupted messages, duplicate requests, denied permissions, partial side effects, and observability. Production components are never mocked; the failure mechanism is the real provider boundary.
